QC Description: A spatial object with wiseEvolutionType value equal to 'changeCode' must not have the same predecessor of another spatial object.
Message: A spatial object with wiseEvolutionType value equal to 'changeCode' must not have the same predecessor of another spatial object. [R224]
Expression:
WITH predecessors -- GET THE PREDECCESSORs 
AS (
	SELECT TRIM(FLATTEN(REGEXP_SPLIT(MS.supersedesidentifier, ',', 'ALL', 999))) AS predecessor
		,MS.thematicididentifier
		,MS.thematicididentifierscheme
		,MS.supersedesidentifierscheme
		,MS.record_id
		,MS.wiseEvolutionType
	FROM dataset_37015."monitoringsite" MS
	WHERE COALESCE(MS."supersedesidentifier", '') <> ''
		
	)
SELECT ori.predecessor, ori.record_id
FROM predecessors ori
INNER JOIN predecessors pred ON 
ORI.predecessor = pred.predecessor
	AND ori.thematicididentifierscheme = pred.thematicididentifierscheme
	--exclude itself
	AND ori.thematicididentifier <> pred.thematicididentifier--
WHERE ori.wiseEvolutionType LIKE 'changeCode'

    select  record_id,
            featureOfInterestIdentifier,
            (
            select  concat(
                    '^',
                    (
                     '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}' 
                    ),
                    '[0-9A-Z]{1}(([0-9A-Z]|\-(?![\-_])|_(?![\-_])){0,38}[0-9A-Z]{1}){0,1}$'

from    Dataset
where   NOT REGEXP_COL_LIKE(featureOfInterestIdentifier, regexp)

WITH predecessors
AS (
	SELECT TRIM(FLATTEN(REGEXP_SPLIT(MS.supersedesidentifier, ',', 'ALL', 999))) AS predecessor
		,MS.thematicididentifier
		,MS.thematicididentifierscheme
		,MS.supersedesidentifierscheme
		,MS.record_id
	FROM dataset_37015."monitoringsite" MS
	WHERE COALESCE(MS."supersedesidentifier", '') <> ''
		
	)
SELECT -- format the list of results
    X.record_id,
    CASE
        WHEN LENGTH(X.ids) > 4000 THEN 
            CONCAT(
                LEFT(
                    X.ids,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN POSITION(',' IN REVERSE(LEFT(X.ids, 3997))) > 0 THEN
                            3997 - POSITION(',' IN REVERSE(LEFT(X.ids, 3997)))
                        ELSE 3997
                    END
                ),
                '...'
            )
        ELSE X.ids
    END AS identifiers,
    X.numberofrecords

        (SELECT MIN(record_id) FROM dataset_37015."monitoringsite") AS record_id,
        listagg(RF.thematicIdIdentifier, ', ') as ids,
        COUNT(*) AS numberofrecords
    FROM dataset_37016."monitoringsiteWFD" RF
    LEFT JOIN dataset_37015."monitoringsite" D
        ON D.thematicIdIdentifier = RF.thematicIdIdentifier
       AND D.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = RF.thematicIdIdentifierScheme
    LEFT JOIN predecessors P
        ON P.predecessor = RF.thematicIdIdentifier
       AND P.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = RF.thematicIdIdentifierScheme
    WHERE RF.countrycode = ( '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'

                        and reportingType = 'WFD'

    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
) X
